name: Grant Privilege
description: Sometimes you have to give permanent benefits to an [estate|e] to gain their support for something in the shorter term.

name: Change Policy
description: This [estate|e] takes issue with our current [policy|e] and would be more supportive if we alter our position to something more preferable.

name: Break Alliance
description: This alliance is against the interest of this [estate|e] and they think it would be beneficial if the [alliance|e] was broken.

name: Reduce Opinion
description: The mere thought of establishing relations with this country enrages this [estate|e] and they demand a strongly worded letter addressed at their ruler this instant.

name: Increase Opinion
description: This [estate|e] would prefer if we establish relations with this country to whatever purpose they have in mind.

name: Shake up Army Academy
description: This [estate|e] is unhappy with the current principles of our military academy and wants us to re-evaluate their teachings.

name: Reduce Army Recruitment
description: The members of this [estate|e] are concerned with our intensive recruitment for the military and want to reduce the amount of people pressed into service.

name: Reduce Navy Recruitment
description: The members of this [estate|e] are concerned with our intensive recruitment for the navy and want to reduce the amount of people pressed into service.

name: Increase Bureaucratic Entrenchment
description: Members of this [estate|e] seem to be pushing for the entrechment of current bureaucracy, likely in an effort to solidify whatever institutional influence they have.

name: Reduce Bureaucratic Entrenchment
description: Members of this [estate|e] seem to be pushing for the reduction of current bureaucracy entrenchment, likely in an effort to limit institutional influence.

name: Aristocratic Movement
description: $push_towards_desc$ embrace the nobility as the highest societal strata.

name: Aristocratic Support
description: $entrench_desc$ elevate the nobility as the highest societal strata.

name: Serfdom Movement
description: $push_towards_desc$ embrace serfdom to the best of our abilities.

name: Serfdom Support
description: $entrench_desc$ enshrine serfdom deeper in our society.

name: Focus on the Land
description: $push_towards_desc$ take more care of our land.

name: Support for Land Focus
description: $entrench_desc$ focus on our presence in our lands.

name: Naval Movement
description: $push_towards_desc$ take more care of our presence at sea.

name: Naval Support
description: $entrench_desc$ focus on our presence on the sea.

name: Mercantilism Movement
description: $push_towards_desc$ embrace mercantilism to the best of our abilities.

name: Mercantilism Support
description: $entrench_desc$ enshrine mercantilism deeper in our society.

name: Demand for a New Monastery
description: Prominent clergymen are petitioning us to construct a remote monastic refuge for them to practice their faith in peace.

name: Demand for a New Marketplace
description: The [estate|e] is petitioning us to construct a new $market_village$ for their mercantile activities.

name: Demand for $city_walls$
description: The citizens are petitioning us to construct new [ShowBuildingTypeNameWithNoTooltip('city_walls')] for their protection.

name: Accept Estate Culture
description: The [estate|e] demands that the dominant [culture|e] of its people be granted official acceptance.

name: Convert to Estate Religion
description: The [estate|e] demands that the country convert to the [religion|e] of its people.

name: Change Court Language
description: The [estate|e] demands that the [court_language|e] be changed to one that better reflects its identity.

name: Lessen Tax Burden
description: We promise to reduce the [ShowPaymentName('imperial_contribution')] obligations they have for their support.

name: Elevate [GetCountry('PRU').GetNameWithNoTooltip] to a [ShowCountryRankNameWithNoTooltip('rank_kingdom')]
description: The monarchs of [GetCountry('PRU').GetName] have always been ambitious in their strife towards power and glory. They formally requested the title of Kings even, though in the end they have to live as 'Kings in [GetCountry('PRU').GetNameWithNoTooltip]'. Elevating this country to a proper [ShowCountryRankName('rank_kingdom')] might gain us the last bit of favor though...

name: Grant Imperial Titles
description: The $elector_plural$ would greatly appreciate additional titles and prestige from the crown.

name: Affirmation of $free_city$ Rights
description: We renew the rights and securities of the $free_city_plural$, ensuring their stability and prosperity within the Empire.
